BC CANNABIS STORES | 5 LOCATIONS ACROSS THE LOWER MAINLAND & FRASER VALLEY

Cannabis Stores | Cannabis Dispensaries

Cannabis Flower

We offer a wide range of cannabis flower strains to suit all types of cannabis consumers. We take pride in providing unique, premium strains that you won’t find anywhere else.

Cannabis Pre-Rolls

Cannabis pre-rolls offer a convenient way to enjoy the benefits of cannabis, delivering consistent quality and flavor in every puff.

Cannabis Edibles & Beverages

Perfectly dosed and artfully crafted, cannabis edibles offer a unique and delicious way to consume cannabis.

Cannabis Concentrates

Extracted using advanced methods, cannabis concentrates capture the essence of each strain in a concentrated form.

Cannabis Vapes

Compact, convenient and discrete cannabis vape products deliver a precise and efficient experience. For the ultimate cannabis vaping experience, try Live Resin Vapes!

Infused Cannabis Pre-Rolls

Infused pre-rolls elevate your smoking experience by combining high-quality cannabis flower with concentrated extracts like oils, kief or both!

Cannabis Topicals

Cannabis topicals offer targeted relief without the high. Pair your products with accessories, from grinders to rolling papers, for the ultimate cannabis experience.

Cannabis Oils & Capsules

For a discreet and easy-to-dose option, cannabis oils and capsules provide precise, long-lasting effects.

Cannabis Accessories

From grinders and rolling papers to pipes, bongs, and storage solutions, our accessories ensure you get the most out of your cannabis experience.

Looking for Cannabis Products in BC?

We carry a huge selection of cannabis flower, pre-rolls, topicals, edibles and beverages the lowest possible prices.

About Us

70 Different Flower Strains On Display

All of our 3.5g cannabis flower options are on display so you can look, feel, and smell before you buy.

100+ Pre-Rolls in Store

We have the best selection of pre-rolled cannabis joints ranging from single joints to over 70 pre-rolled joints in a single bag!

Lowest Pricing

We offer high quality products at the lowest prices possible to ensure we have the right product for every budget!

Knowledgeable Staff

Our knowledgeable staff is here to guide you through your cannabis journey, providing expert advice on product selection, dosages, and effects.

What Our Customers Are Saying

"Great selection, lowest prices for miles, and super nice staff. What more could you ask for? Always happy to visit this place."
David Racz Mission, BC
"The staff, knowledge and the sheer amount of stuff they carry is worth it alone. Not to mention great prices and lots of BC grown products."
Scott Logan Mission, BC
"The best dispensary in Mission! Excellent friendly staff always have the best suggestions, great inventory, and very clean. Only place to shop in my opinion."
Erika W Mission, BC
